name: @cloudsforge/aetherholm-assets
description: The Aetherholm art set, and the run that produced it. Images plus a provenance manifest; the generation engine lives in the sibling studio service and the art specification lives in the game the estate ships (aetherholm/src/content.ts), and neither is duplicated here.
_noDependencies: This package has no dependencies and no node_modules of its own, on purpose.
generate.ts imports four modules from ../studio/src — backend, specs, sizing and the licence
constant from assets — and plan.ts imports the shipped game content from
../aetherholm/src/content.ts and world.ts. All of them are dependency-free, so nothing has
to be installed to read them; what the studio modules encode is every verified fact about
the FLUX 2 Pro endpoint, and what the game content encodes is the identity of every
building, ship, resource and band. A second copy of either here would be a second place for
it to rot — doc 20 §4 planned the content JSON to live in THIS repository, and the
inversion of that plan (the service is the canon) is recorded in the README.
The consequence is that this repository is NOT self-contained: a RUN needs the sibling
checkouts beside it. The ARTEFACTS are self-contained — the PNGs, MANIFEST.json and
PLAN.json carry everything needed to audit what was made and from what.
normalise_ground.py is pure standard library. derive.py, sheet.py and verify.py need
Pillow. Not sips: design-system.md section 7 item 3 names sips as the reason the estate's
resize step once existed on exactly one laptop.

scripts._run: Run from the studio workspace so tsx resolves out of its node_modules.
